hub.catalogState: The public page says the electronic catalogue is still in progress.
hub.imageReuseNote: The hub asks users intending research or commercial image use to coordinate with the center. This is an image-use notice, not a data license.

publication.citation: Rula et al. (2020), The VIP CORALS Marine Repository Hub: Laying foundations for science and discovery in the VIP, Philippine Science Letters 13(1), 72-75.

rightsAndScope.decision: Keep this as an official metadata and access lead only. Do not convert the 44 fish specimens into 44 species, species assertions, dated observations, station geometry, or app content. Seek item-specific catalogue fields and reuse terms before any extraction.

limits: The five public fish tiles are generic image labels and do not identify taxa.
The 2020 paper reports 44 fish specimens, not 44 fish species.
The reviewed public pages do not provide a complete species list, specimen-level collection dates, station coordinates, or a downloadable catalogue table.
The image-use coordination request does not establish the reuse terms for specimen metadata or derived species data.
This source review establishes neither current presence nor abundance, catchability, legal access, safety, or habitat geometry.
